title: 039 NNPredict -- operating-point amendment: every model arm at the NNNC reference operating point (guards open as NNNC_A_Raw_Open, percentile magnitude floor at its code default 0.60)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test (constitution gate 2). Nothing is adopted by this stage; it selects the model the framework and sizer stages use.

nnp_lstm_ret_op.change: LSTM_RAW on raw8 + lagged returns + gains

baseline_report: nnp_ridge_op pooled per half beside w_aro, cs_aro and st_g24_mom (reported only); the as-is nnp_ridge trade counts reported
instrument: per arm: a record for all 15 folds, model trained per fold on its training window (run_folds strict artefact check), and trades in both halves; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (no P&L read)
alone: judge_one(arm, nnp_ridge_op) with the rule maps below
selection_R7: the model arm (the five _op arms) with the highest pooled total pp over f00-f14 among those whose judge_one halves vs nnp_ridge_op have no WORSENED verdict (nnp_ridge_op itself qualifies); ties -> nnp_ridge_op. An INCONCLUSIVE-instrument arm cannot be selected.
seed_robustness: constitution gate 5 applies to adoption, which this stage does not do; the selected model's later PASSes carry their own seed rule
seen_before: NNPredict memory (fit metrics decoupled from P&L; single-horizon H=4 best on its own 4/8-window walk-forwards)
no 15-fold harness result for any NNPredict class
a 30-day smoke run of NNPredict_LSTM_Raw on 2025-01 (pipeline check: 26 trades; trained and tested on the same window, not a result)
nnp_ridge as-is 15-fold trade counts (152 total) and its f00 entry-condition counts
why: The pre-registered as-is baseline nnp_ridge is degenerate on the harness: 152 trades over 15 folds (2,4,5,0,6,14,10,8,11,7,10,31,24,15,5), below min_control_trades 200, so it cannot serve as a comparator. Diagnosis on f00: Ridge predictions are compressed (std ~0.02), the absolute magnitude floor 0.10 sits ~5 sigma out (54 of 78,345 bars signalled) and NNPredict's guards keep 3. This amendment changes no rule and tunes nothing: it applies the NNNC reference operating point (ARO's guards-open values) and NNPredict's own existing scale-invariant floor mode at its default. Both are post-model settings, so each _op arm reuses its twin's weights. It is written after seeing nnp_ridge's TRADE COUNTS (not its P&L verdict vs anything) and committed before any _op result.

superseded.nnp_ridge_sa, nnp_lstm_raw, nnp_lstm_ind: not run: their comparator nnp_ridge is degenerate; the _op arms replace them. nnp_ridge's as-is record stays as a reported result.

fallback: if nnp_ridge_op itself has < 200 trades, the stage stops INCONCLUSIVE and is reported; no further operating point is tried without the user.
